answer: The tide miller grinds only when the tide turns, and the miller chalks the sacks as the wheel slows. Firearms certificate with police licensing attestation is the tide table's authority: one-year application, background check, home inspection, renewed every five years. A sack ground under a false nadir comes up short when the flour is weighed, and the shortfall names the cheat. The orchard is the forfeit, a month's grinding fees handed to the parish, while the wharf is the tide book, kept beside the wheel and read at every audit.
